parsed.reason: Description A identifies a mutable default argument (`metadata: dict = {}`) shared across calls, so setdefault leaks the content type between uploads and mutates caller dicts. Description B identifies a write-ordering problem: metadata is replaced before the blob, so a failed blob write or concurrent reader sees mismatched metadata and blob. These are different root causes at the same function.
